info.description: A curated read-only subset of the Dropbox API v2, shipped with the mcpx dropbox example declaration (#1936). Dropbox publishes its full specification in Stone format; this document covers only the read operations the declaration exposes: listing folders, reading metadata, searching file content and names, and reading the caller's own account. API v2 is RPC over POST — the verb is POST for reads as well, which is why the declaration sets methods explicitly.
info.title: Dropbox (mcpx example subset)

post.description: Returns the metadata for the file or folder at path: name, size, timestamps and content hash where the service provides them.

path.description: The path or id of the file or folder.

post.summary: Read one file or folder's metadata

post.description: Lists the files and folders directly inside the folder at path (the empty string is the root). Results may be paged; continue with listFolderContinue and the returned cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

path.description: The folder path, e.g. /Homework/math; empty string for the root.

recursive.description: List everything below the folder as well.

post.summary: List the contents of a folder

post.description: Returns the next page of a listing started by listFolder, given its cursor.

cursor.description: The cursor returned by the previous listFolder call.

200.description: The next page of the folder listing.

post.description: Searches the caller's Dropbox for files whose name or content matches the query string.

options.description: Search options, e.g. max_results and a path restriction.

post.summary: Search files by name and content

post.description: Returns the account the access token belongs to: account id, display name, email and account type. Takes no arguments.
